data.one_liner: A plugin that reports software keyboard visibility and size on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Reports keyboard visibility and size through a unified or platform-specific API. Provides a SuperKeyboardBuilder widget to build UI subtrees based on the keyboard state.
use_when: You need to build widget subtrees that react to keyboard visibility and geometry changes.
You want unified keyboard state listening across both iOS and Android.
avoid_when: You require precise visual keyboard height reporting on iOS during open and close transitions.
strengths: Unified cross-platform API for keyboard events
Provides platform-specific APIs for advanced or platform-dependent control
Includes keyboard testing and simulation utilities
weaknesses: Limited by underlying platform APIs, meaning iOS height during transitions will not match the visual keyboard
data.setup_notes: Supports iOS and Android out of the box.
